title: He Lost The Plot
description:

Criticizing U.S. involvement in Iran is completely reasonable. People can worry about another quagmire, the loss of American lives, or resources being spent abroad. Those are legitimate debates.

But Tucker’s argument went much further.

comments.text:
Historically speaking, "unconditional surrender" means surrender without any pre-negotiated terms.

In WW2, unconditional surrender was demanded of Germany and Japan. It was agreed upon by the "big 3" Allied leaders to ensure that no separate agreements would be made with these Axis states by any Allied power. The Soviets worried about the US and UK doing this, and the US and UK were concerned about the USSR making such an agreement.

When Germany surrendered, areas of the country under US, UK, Canadian, and French occupation were immediately secured by those armies, with military law - which explicitly banned fraternization, let alone anything more - in effect.

After the transition to occupation government those laws gradually transitioned to civilian law. But AT NO POINT was rape allowed or accepted in the British, American, and French occupation zones.

The USSR, on the other hand, allowed its armies to largely run wild, specifically in Berlin, committing rape and other crimes.

In Japan, the wartime government told Japanese people that occupation would mean mass rape of women and girls. This was done to discourage surrender.

The result was mass suicide by Japanese civilians on Pacific islands that were faced with occupation. This was used to provoke civilians on Okinawa to attack American soldiers.

And it was completely untrue.

The Allied occupation zones were governed under military law, which forbade fraternization, let alone rape.

Tucker Carlson is a moron, a fool, a buffoon.
